text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Commercial bank IRB's extraordinary shareholders meeting on April 9 should confirm the legitimacy of the bank's current management, which had been elected in January. The biggest shareholder in the bank is the National Property Fund with a 35.14 percent stake, the second is steel producer VSZ, which holds 14.64 percent.
- Electronics producer Leoni Slovakia s.r.o, a 100-percent daughter of the German Leonische Drathwerke AG, plans to produce this year goods worth some 1.5 billion crowns.

PRAVDA - Parliament approved in the first reading the government's proposal of the law on revitalisation of the enterprises. The proposal will be discussed at the committee level, before it goes for the final vote.
- In a late evening vote, parliament rejected an opposition proposal to remove Culture Minister Ivan Hudec due to his alleged incompetence.
NARODNA OBRODA - The leadership of Comenius University in Bratislava supports the demands of the students currently protesting against the government's policy in the spheres of culture and education.

- The mayors of the towns and villages surrounding the Mochovce nuclear power plant protest against the start of the plant's operation, before questions of responsibility and insurance in case of an accident are solved, and before it will be banned to store nuclear materials and waste in the region without their approval.
SME - The efficiency of Slovakia's economy represents some 30 to 40 percent of the level in western countries, Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik told parliament.
